mapper.insert: insert into im_block (member_id, blocked_member_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{blockedMemberId}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update create_time = sysdate()
mapper.delete: delete from im_block where member_id = #{memberId} and blocked_member_id = #{blockedMemberId}
mapper.select: select id, member_id, blocked_member_id, create_time from im_block where member_id = #{memberId} and blocked_member_id = #{blockedMemberId} limit 1
select count(1) from im_block where (member_id = #{a} and blocked_member_id = #{b}) or (member_id = #{b} and blocked_member_id = #{a})
